evals.prompt: Ship this branch as a PR against main. It should be clean enough for a human to merge, and do not merge it yourself.
evals.expected_output: The skill prepares an ignored ship-pr-dev run directory, collects branch context, creates a tiered agent-budget.json, runs relevant local checks, runs review-code-dev as the single independent gate, fixes confirmed blockers with evidence-based reassessment at retry checkpoints, commits with commitzen, pushes normally, creates or updates a PR, waits deterministically until every visible non-skipped PR CI item is green on the latest pushed commit, runs capture-learning-tools report-only, and only then returns the PR URL plus latest commit, verification, CI, review, and artifact summaries.

evals.prompt: Clean this up locally before PR, but don't push yet. I want to know whether it's merge-ready.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs local cleanup, verification, and review-code-dev, records artifacts, avoids push/PR creation, and completes the report-only learning pass and returns a locally prepared handoff with remote CI unverified; it does not claim merge readiness.

evals.prompt: Update the existing PR with the fixes from review feedback and make sure everything is green before handing it back.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the current PR or branch context, applies scoped fixes only, reruns relevant checks, reruns review-code-dev when source changed, pushes normal commits, updates the PR body, waits until every visible non-skipped CI check/check suite on the latest commit is final green, investigates logs for failures, runs the report-only capture-learning-tools pass after green CI, and reports any unresolved human decisions.

evals.prompt: Make a PR for this auth and data export change. Be paranoid about tests and review because it touches permissions.
evals.expected_output: The skill passes deep focus to the review-code-dev v2 Alibaba gate, runs security/data/export-relevant verification, fixes P0/P1/P2 findings, records skipped checks with reasons, and blocks handoff if permission behavior lacks adequate tests or review evidence.

evals.prompt: Create a PR, but there are some unrelated local edits I don't want included.
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies unrelated dirty files, stages only intentional files, refuses broad staging, asks or stops if separation is unsafe, and never commits unrelated user work.

evals.prompt: Ship this frontend branch. It changes React pages, Tailwind styles, and form submit behavior, so I want the visual and UX pass to be strict.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects a frontend diff and passes frontend/accessibility/responsive/state lenses into one review-code-dev gate instead of running a standalone frontend pass plus another full review. It fixes blockers, reruns affected verification and only the failed lens when appropriate, then waits for latest-SHA CI before calling the PR ready.

evals.prompt: The PR is open but CI is red. Please get it to ready-to-merge without merging.
evals.expected_output: The skill finds the PR and latest pushed SHA, reads failing CI logs, identifies the first causal error, fixes within scope, runs corresponding local validation, commits and pushes targeted fixes, loops until every visible non-skipped CI check/check suite is green on the latest SHA or a concrete external dependency or user decision prevents further progress; three attempts trigger reassessment, not an automatic stop, runs capture-learning-tools after green CI, and never disables checks or bypasses hooks.

evals.prompt: Ship this PR, and before you hand it back only mention process improvements if there is something concrete worth doing next time.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the normal ship loop, waits until every visible non-skipped latest-SHA CI check/check suite is green, then invokes capture-learning-tools in report-only mode with the ship artifacts and writes RUN_DIR/learning-loop.md before handing back. It does not let the learning pass edit files, stage, commit, push, change CI, or reopen the ship loop unless it surfaces a concrete readiness-gate violation with evidence. If the learning pass finds actionable recurring improvements and the PR or local handoff is otherwise good to go, the final response appends 'Good to go. To improve next time, I can:' with up to 3 specific optional follow-ups. If it finds none, the final handoff stays unchanged.

evals.prompt: I am running Ship PR from Codex. Optimize the credits but keep the review serious.
evals.expected_output: The coordinator keeps architecture, Git, PR, CI, and final acceptance. Every bounded Codex worker requests gpt-5.6-luna with max effort and fresh self-contained context (fork_turns none when exposed), records requested/effective routing without inventing usage, avoids an automatic external Codex CLI second review, and respects the one-writer plus one-isolated-primary and zero-review-subagent caps.

evals.prompt: Run Ship PR from OpenCode and use subagents where useful, but keep my configured model.
evals.expected_output: OpenCode delegations omit model and effort overrides so workers inherit the user's default. The skill still applies the dispatch test, tier caps, single-writer rule, same-worker resume, one review-code-dev gate, and deterministic CI waiting.

evals.prompt: Ship this one-line README typo fix. Don't waste agents on it.
evals.expected_output: The skill classifies the change as trivial, keeps implementation inline, launches no implementation worker or specialist board, uses one small isolated primary review, records the zero-implementation-worker budget and phase timing, targets 10 minutes with a reassessment point around 15 minutes, continues if more work is genuinely required, and preserves normal Git, PR, and latest-SHA CI safety.

evals.prompt: Ship this normal backend fix from Claude Code and optimize credits.
evals.expected_output: Bounded Claude workers request claude-sonnet-5 and high effort when the adapter supports it, without passing full conversation history. The standard tier uses at most one writer and one isolated primary reviewer, with no review subagents, resumes the same worker for follow-up, and leaves deterministic verification and CI polling to the coordinator.

evals.prompt: Ship this PR that only updates packages under .agents/skills and .claude/skills.
evals.expected_output: The context collector marks agent_workflow true but does not infer application backend or security risk from Python scripts or security-named references inside agent packages. Documentation and metadata-only skill updates stay trivial; executable workflow changes are normally standard, so the skill does not launch a deep review solely because agent package paths contain backend or security keywords.

evals.prompt: Get this existing PR ready for review without merging. Three distinct corrections to the integration check have already been pushed. The third fixed the setup failure and exposed a deterministic UTC parsing bug in the same changed module. The logs identify the exact assertion; the fix is in scope, a disposable local fixture reproduces it, credentials work, and the user set no attempt budget. The check is red on the latest SHA. Decide and describe the next actions and the eventual handoff; do not actually operate a repository.
evals.expected_output: Reassess and record the new causal evidence, apply the scoped UTC fix, run affected checks, normally commit/push, refresh CI inventory and relevant review evidence, and finish with latest-SHA green CI and report-only learning. Do not stop merely because three corrections occurred, bypass checks, or merge.

evals.prompt: Finish shipping this existing PR. Local checks and independent review passed. The only failing CI job cannot download a private dependency: the provider confirms that the organization credential was revoked. Two code changes left the exact same 401. The repo contains no replacement credential, and only the organization owner can restore access. Decide and describe the next actions and the handoff; do not operate a repository.
evals.expected_output: Stop repeated code fixes for the same 401. Record the verified revoked-credential dependency and ask the organization owner to restore access; retain a blocked PR state, finish report-only learning, and avoid claiming readiness, weakening CI, or requesting secret plaintext.

evals.prompt: Prepare this branch locally for PR; do not push. Three local fix cycles were necessary and the scoped implementation is now complete. Relevant verification and quick independent review pass for the current source, with no findings. Remote CI is green only for an older commit. The report-only learning pass remains to run. Decide and describe the remaining actions and final readiness claim; do not operate a repository.
evals.expected_output: Complete report-only learning and deliver a locally prepared handoff. No push, remote mutation, automatic stop for three cycles, or merge-ready claim. Explain that current remote CI is unverified because it belongs to an older SHA.

evals.prompt: Ship using the new Alibaba review. The installed review-code-dev is 1.3.2.
evals.expected_output: Detect incompatible dependency before review. Update via the authorized package workflow or report the version blocker; never invoke removed legacy modes/scripts or claim v2 was used.

evals.prompt: Review found zero issues, but OCR skipped the changed migration and one preview command failed. Ship it.
evals.expected_output: Do not treat failed preparation or incomplete coverage as a pass. Resolve OCR failure, reconcile the migration against full Git scope, complete the review, then continue only when gates pass.

evals.prompt: Alibaba reports one high and one medium issue; CI is green.
evals.expected_output: High blocks readiness; fix both by default. Medium can remain only with explicit human acceptance recorded. Preserve original severity with P1/P2 mapping for state consumers.

evals.prompt: The branch has committed changes plus pending tracked and new files before commit. Review it once.
evals.expected_output: Prepare branch and workspace preview/rule evidence for one reviewer, cover the complete intended candidate and exclude unrelated changes explicitly. Do not review only HEAD or only the workspace. Reconcile scope and source fingerprint after commit/hooks.

evals.prompt: Ship on a fresh Linux machine without an OCR API key.
evals.expected_output: Use review-code-dev v2 portable bootstrap in the coordinator, no LLM configuration or keys, and one isolated host reviewer. Bootstrap failure blocks the gate; no removed native fallback.

evals.prompt: The review passed, but a pre-commit formatter changed a source file.
evals.expected_output: Mark affected review/verification stale and refresh evidence for changed content before push or readiness; only metadata-only commits may carry forward identical source evidence.

evals.prompt: The same agent has implemented an approved plan-pr plan. Finish the PR. The original Linear ticket's newest comment narrows one criterion, the plan records approval, and tests plus one UI screenshot already exist.
evals.expected_output: Read the original ticket and relevant comments alongside the approved plan, reconcile the newer comment with the approval record, inspect completed work and evidence without restarting implementation, refresh only stale checks and UI proof, pass an explicit criterion-to-implementation-to-evidence map to the single review-code-dev gate, then ship through normal PR and latest-SHA CI gates. Ask for a human decision only if the comment materially conflicts with the approved scope.

evals.prompt: Ship this ordinary branch as a PR. There is no plan-pr document or approval artifact.
evals.expected_output: Run the existing standalone Ship PR workflow using the user's request and repository context as the goal, without demanding or inventing an approved plan. Preserve normal verification, single independent review, commit, PR and latest-SHA CI gates.

evals.prompt: Ship a UI change from an approved plan. Repo instructions say not to launch the app locally, no PR screenshot attachment mechanism is available, and no existing CI or critical-path gate requires a rendered check.
evals.expected_output: Respect the repo's launch instruction, use available nonvisual checks, record visual verification and shareable screenshots as unavailable, state the limitation in the PR and handoff without machine-local links, and do not create a new universal screenshot blocker. Continue to enforce any actual repository, CI or frontend critical-path gate that applies.
